message.content:
**Ambrosia is both**—in Greek mythology, it is described as the **food or drink of the gods**, and ancient sources do not use the terms completely consistently.[2][3]

In many accounts, **ambrosia is treated as food**, while **nectar is the drink**.[2][3][5][6] However, some ancient texts and later retellings also describe ambrosia as a **liquid or beverage**, so the safest answer is that it can be **either**, depending on the source.[1][2][3]
